atoms.html: The reason why it can't intersect: VAT can’t handle intersections well because it only replays baked per-vertex positions from textures (no collision/self-collision or surface-ordering info), so when parts overlap, the mesh can’t resolve which side should be in front, causing clipping/flicker/tearing.
